title: Portrait of Mitch Miller
description: A photographed record of Yi Kai’s oil portrait of Mitch Miller. Seated beside an open musical score, the subject gestures with both hands against a warm, softly worked background. The handwritten caption dates the painting to 1991 and records its dimensions as 30 × 40 inches.

title: Portrait of Dolly Fiterman
description: Dolly Fiterman is shown seated in a red patterned dress, with a painting behind her. The handwritten note identifies the sitter and records an oil painting measuring 55 × 58 inches. The photograph carries a 2003 date stamp; the painting’s completion year is not recorded here.

title: A portrait and its exhibition history
description: An archival photograph of a portrait with dark glasses and a star-patterned cap, labelled Man wear flag. The printed caption identifies acrylic on rice paper, 36 × 36 inches, dated 2002. Handwritten notes record a Plains Art Museum exhibition and selection for a 2003 drawing exhibition in Santa Fe.

title: Shepherd Girl: an exhibition certificate
description: A certificate addressed to Yi Kai and Zhao Tuo records a third prize for Shepherd Girl at the Second National Youth Art Exhibition. The printed text gives the exhibition dates as December 21, 1980 to January 20, 1981, at the National Art Museum of China in Beijing.

title: The Museum Year, 1995–1996
description: The cover of The Museum Year 1995–1996, published by the Minnesota Museum of American Art. Its red, blue and cream artwork brings painted marks and written symbols into a single field. Preserved in the artist’s archive, the publication sits alongside records of his work in museum collections.
